Project.Name: GraphColoring
Project.Description: This project compares five heuristic algorithms for the Graph Coloring Problem: Greedy, Welsh-Powell, DSatur, RLF (Recursive Largest First), and MSISCA (Malatya Sequential Independent Set Coloring Algorithm). Algorithms are evaluated on four groups of test graphs: classic graphs with known chromatic numbers, real-world social network graphs, random Erdos-Renyi graphs, and DIMACS-style benchmark graphs (Queen and Mycielski graphs). The main quality indicator is the number of colors used (NumColors); execution time is measured to assess the time/quality trade-off of each algorithm.
